Depending upon your level, interest, and learning goals, topics can include: entertainment, sports, travel, hobbies, food, people, history, and any questions or topics that are best for you. This class is your chance to improve your fluency, and build on your English speaking skills in a natural and comfortable learning environment with an experienced ESL teacher.

I look forward to talking to you soon.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing Revision and Correction - "Not In-Class" -  (IELTS, TOEFL, Academic, Business, and Creative)
pro_course_detail.description:
Please Note: This is not an in-class lesson. 

After you have scheduled your Writing Lesson, you will send me the writing you want revised and corrected upon (I can also send you a writing topic/essay-question that fits your needs if you prefer). 

I will use the scheduled time to go over, correct, and when necessary give comments on your writing and send it back to you, showing the corrections. 

I am qualified to work with you in improving/revising: Test (IELTS and TOEFL), Academic, Business, and Creative Writing. This writing lesson can come in 30, 45, or 60 minute time-slots. 

See below for a summary of what each time-slot covers relevant to your needs.

IELTS
30 minute time slot = One Task 1 essay (150-250 words)
45 minute time slot = One Task 2 essay (250-350 words)
60 minute time slot = One Task 1 essay (150-250 words) and One task 2 essay (250-350 words)

TOEFL
30 minute time slot = One Integrated Writing Task (150-225 words)
45 minute time slot = One Independent Writing Task (250-300 words)
60 minute time slot = One Integrated Writing Task (150-225 words) and One Independent 
Writing Task (250-300 words)

Academic/Business/Creative
30 minute time slot = One piece of writing (150-250 words maximum) 
45 minute time slot = One piece of writing (250-300 words maximum)
60 minute time slot = One or more pieces of writing (300-700 words maximum - in total)
90 minute time slot = One or more pieces of writing (700-negotiable words maximum - in total)

If you send me your completed writing before the start of your scheduled time slot, I will return your revised/corrected writing to you before the end of the day (my day/time). And if you have any questions about your writing before booking a lesson please feel free to ask. 

I look forward to working with you soon. 

Also: A Ten Class Savers' Package can be made available if you are interested in booking larger lesson packages. Please let me know if you are interested in this package.

pro_course_detail.description:
The (4) Four Elements to Speaking English. 

Reading; Students will be required to read an article, paragraph, or a story. Promotes: pronunciation, sentence structure, interduces new words to the student(s) vocabulary, understanding and confidence. 

Listening; Students listen to the article that is read. Promotes: listening to pronunciation of words, sentence structure, understanding, thinking and confidents. 

Speaking; Students will express their opinions, ideas, and understanding of the topic and communicate with other people. Promotes: sentence structure, communication, pronunciation thinking and confidents. 

Writing; Students will be required to practice their writing skills at home. Quizzes and practice tests will be given to the students to do at home and reviewed for the next lesson. Promotes: interest and responsibility.
